The Artist

Maison Noire
From the Heart
of Maqio

Mason Nouai grew up in Maqio — a place where the coast meets the hills and time moves slowly. For years he painted for himself: filling sketchbooks, covering walls, living inside color.

Maqio gave him something rare — a way of seeing. The particular quality of light at midday. The textures of stone and sea. The way silence looks when nothing is in a hurry.

One day he decided that world belonged to everyone. Every painting is made by hand, with patience, with quality materials — and sold at prices that make it possible to bring real art home.

Mason Nouai
From the village of Maqio
